The knight replied, “You do very wrong.” And he raised his crutch and dealt the rabbi a great blow on the head. Because disputing with unbelievers is dangerous enough, though learned scholars who can hold their own against them may do it—for if it goes badly, if the Jews win the public disputation, some good Christian there might end up with his ideas confused, so one must be careful.
